cohort: 4200 women who delivered at a tertiary hospital in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
finding: The study identified a high overall CS rate (34.7%) with significant contributions from Robson Group 10 (previous CS), Group 2 (nulliparous, single cephalic, term, spontaneous labor), Group 5 (previous CS with labor), and Group 4 (nulliparous, single cephalic, term, induced labor), indicating areas for potential intervention to reduce unnecessary CS.
